_: The benchmark arms (R-EVAL-2). Each arm is one provider configuration. Prices are per million INPUT tokens, with the page they were read from and the date. Edit this file to add an engine: no code changes.

readers.note: Brit's own regex readers, sliced unchanged from app/v3/next.html. The baseline System One provider. Covers halt, still, follow, unfollow only.

ngram.note: On-device linear model over hashed n-grams, trained on the tuning split. One JSON file per route.

minilm-zeroshot.note: On-device all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (ONNX, quantized). No training: nearest option description.

minilm-head.note: Same embeddings, one linear layer trained on the tuning split.

jev.note: TypeSafe's own serving, reached through OpenRouter.

clef.note: Cloudflare Workers AI's own serving, reached through OpenRouter.

clef-flash.note: Cloudflare Workers AI's own serving, reached through OpenRouter.

clef@primeintellect.note: The same open weights on another host (PrimeIntellect), to show what the host changes.

clef-flash@primeintellect.note: The same open weights on another host (PrimeIntellect), to show what the host changes.

llama8b-groq.note: The fast small generative model Brit named (Groq). No logprobs on this host: the pick carries p = 1.

llama8b-logprobs.note: The same model on a host that returns logprobs, so its confidence can be calibrated.

gemini-flash.note: The model family the app's brain runs on (next.html), asked ONLY this route's question. Not today's full brain turn: no 13k-token prompt, no reply to write. A reference for what a large model makes of the same question. No logprobs: the pick carries p = 1.
